items.title: 'Unbelievable' - how Spurs teenager Williams-Barnett impressed on first start
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Joe Hart explains how teenager Luca Williams-Barnett caused problems for Ipswich Town on his first Premier League start for Tottenham in their 2-0 home win.

items.title: I wish referee had opportunity to see 'handball' again - Hart
items.description: Match of the Day pundits Joe Hart and Alan Shearer disagree with Morgan Rogers being penalised for handball, as the Chelsea forward "didn't make himself bigger" with the use of his arms in his side's 4-1 defeat to Leeds United in the Premier League.

items.title: Naderi's 'lucky punch' keeps Rangers in touch
items.description: On a Saturday laden with Scottish Premiership goals, Ryan Naderi's was far from the most impressive - but vital for Rangers all the same.

items.title: London City keep up title hunt with emphatic win over Crystal Palace
items.description: London City Lionesses stay in the hunt for the Women's Super League title, with a statement second-half performance to give them a 6-2 win over Crystal Palace.

items.title: 'They looked like a team again' - Hearts  roar back with Dundee demolition
items.description: After a worrying week before the international break, Hearts respond is style by thrashing Dundee 8-0 at Dens Park.

items.title: Spurs latest: 'Williams-Barnett has to be given assist for my goal!' says Solanke
De Zerbi compares Williams-Barnett to Lamine Yamal - who is Spurs teen?
items.description: Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi was not surprised by a dazzling full-debut display from “special” talent Luca Williams-Barnett and compared the 18-year-old to Barcelona’s Lamine Yamal after Saturday’s 2-0 win over Ipswich.

items.title: Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
items.description: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.
